annotations.text: Portrait is a marked placeholder — there is no founder photo in /public/assets. Drop one in and it replaces the plate.

Every fact here comes from the site's own content: the name, role and quote from the About page; 1950s / 2013 / Today from the Timeline; the four figures and principles from about.jsx. Nothing invented.

Motion reuses about.css exactly: the same cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.68, 0.24, 1), 1.5s reveals, 0.16s stagger.

Hero — name rises out of a mask, texture parallaxes, rice grains drift up, scroll cue pulses.
Quote — words lift one at a time in reading order.
Story — gold rails draw left-to-right, staggered.
Figures — count up from zero when the band arrives.
Principles — pointer tilt, icons rotate on hover.

All of it turns off under prefers-reduced-motion, and reveals are armed by JS so a failed observer means nothing stays hidden.
Alt hero only — swaps for section 01 of the desktop page. Portrait leads and the quote moves up into the hero; calmer and more formal, but it pushes the story further down the page.
